title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
task: Training agent skills via text-space optimization
key_results: SkillOpt beats competitors on all 52 (model, benchmark, harness) cells; +23.5 points on GPT-4o in direct chat
comments: First systematic controllable optimizer for skill evolution; treats skill document as frozen-agent state to optimize with reproducible discipline.

outputs: bounded add/delete/replace edits on skill document

hypotheses.hypothesis: Skill as external state with frozen agent enables reproducible optimization

title: Rethinking Cross-Layer Information Routing in Diffusion Transformers
task: Improving diffusion transformer information routing
key_results: DAR improves SiT-XL/2 by 2.11 FID (7.56 vs 9.67); 8.75× fewer training iterations; 2× early-stage acceleration with REPA
comments: Identifies residual-stream bottleneck via empirical diagnosis; learnable timestep-adaptive aggregation orthogonal to existing methods.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Traditional residual addition causes monotonic magnitude inflation and gradient decay in DiTs
hypotheses.result: DAR's learnable non-incremental aggregation resolves symptoms and accelerates training

title: Lens: Rethinking Training Efficiency for Foundational Text-to-Image Models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dense captions and multi-resolution batching maximize data information density
hypotheses.result: Competitive performance with <6B parameter models at 19.3% training compute

title: SciAtlas: A Large-Scale Knowledge Graph for Automated Scientific Research
task: Knowledge graph for automated scientific research

comments: Shifts from keyword/vector-search to topological reasoning; reduces inference cost for agentic deep-research frameworks.

model_io.model: Neuro-symbolic retrieval (tri-path collaborative recall + graph reranking)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured topological graph reduces logical hallucination and inference cost vs. vector-space methods
hypotheses.result: Enables literature review, trend synthesis, idea positioning, and trajectory exploration

title: StepAudio 2.5 Technical Report
task: Unified audio-language foundation for ASR, TTS, and dialogue
key_results: State-of-the-art on ASR, TTS, Realtime benchmarks; single backbone supports three operational modes via task-tailored RLHF

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared multimodal representational space + task-tailored RLHF unifies speech understanding, generation, and interaction
hypotheses.result: Single model matches specialized system performance across all three modalities

title: See What I Mean: Aligning Vision and Language Representations for Video Fine-grained Object Understanding
task: Fine-grained video object understanding from text prompts
key_results: SWIM outperforms visual-prompt methods on fine-grained benchmarks; eliminates need for masks at inference
comments: Addresses cross-attention misalignment: attribute words sharp, object nouns diffuse; mask supervision only at train time guides attention.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enforcing spatial consistency of object-noun cross-attention maps with ground-truth masks aligns vision-language representations
hypotheses.result: Model learns to attend user-specified objects without masks at inference

title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills
task: Understanding model-generated agent skill lifecycle
key_results: Model-generated skills beneficial on average but exhibit negative transfer; utility independent of model scale; meta-skill reduces negative transfer
comments: Comprehensive study spanning extraction, consumption, and transfer; shows skill utility depends on consumer's ability, not extractor quality or model scale.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Skill utility depends on extractor-consumer compatibility and feature alignment, not model scale
hypotheses.result: Meta-skill guidance toward utility-tied features improves quality and reduces negative transfer

title: PiD: Fast and High-Resolution Latent Decoding with Pixel Diffusion
task: Fast high-resolution decoding via pixel-space diffusion
key_results: PiD decodes 512² latents to 2048² in <1s (RTX 5090) or 210ms (GB200); 6× faster than cascaded super-resolution; 4-step distilled version available
comments: Reformulates latent-to-pixel as conditional pixel diffusion; enables early termination of latent diffusion process.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pixel-space diffusion with sigma-aware conditioning enables generative upsampling vs. reconstruction
hypotheses.result: 4-8× upsampling with low latency and better fidelity than cascaded approaches

title: PhotoFlow: Agentic 3D Virtual Photography Missions
task: Language-conditioned virtual photography in 3D scenes
key_results: PhotoFlow achieves strongest quality-alignment composite on VPhotoBench (47 Blender scenes, 141 missions); outperforms one-shot, single-chain, and anchor-bank methods
comments: Director-Reviewer-Reflector agent with closed-loop search; first to make language-conditioned photography in arbitrary Blender scenes executable.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-stage agent (propose → review → reflect) balances 3D spatial understanding and aesthetic judgment
hypotheses.result: Strongest quality and success rate vs. prediction and reflection baselines

title: VGenST-Bench: A Benchmark for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning via Active Video Synthesis
task: Evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning in MLLMs via active synthesis

comments: Shifts from passive curation to active synthesis; enables fine-grained diagnosis of spatio-temporal understanding.

model_io.model: Generative video synthesis + multi-agent QA pipeline

hypotheses.hypothesis: Active synthesis enables fine-grained evaluation of spatio-temporal reasoning decoupled from dataset bias
hypotheses.result: Hierarchical tasks reveal perception-vs-reasoning bottlenecks

title: RankE: End-to-End Post-Training for Discrete Text-to-Image Generation with Decoder Co-Evolution

comments: First end-to-end post-training for discrete AR; addresses latent covariate shift via co-evolved policy-decoder optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Policy-only RL induces latent covariate shift; co-evolution via ranking-based alignment resolves trade-off
hypotheses.result: Simultaneous improvement in both reward (CLIP) and reconstruction (FID) metrics

title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning
task: Reasoning-aware image editing for VLM understanding
key_results: ETCHR raises Pass@1 by +4.82 (Qwen3-VL-8B), +5.47 (Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite), +4.61 (Kimi K2.5); decoupled editor plugs into different MLLMs
comments: Addresses language-side and generation-side gaps via Reasoning Imitation SFT + VLM-derived reward enhancement; training-free deployment.

model_io.model: Decoupled question-conditioned image editor + downstream MLLM

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupled, reasoning-aware editor trained on edit trajectories and VLM rewards improves visual reasoning more than unified methods

title: SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models
task: World modeling for FPS games with selective control
key_results: SCOPE enables zero-shot cross-game generalization on 7 FPS titles; precise scope separation without segmentation labels; strong action responsiveness
comments: Observes FPS actions are spatially selective (in-scope firing/reload vs. out-of-scope movement); per-pixel temporal sequences decouple effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatially-selective action conditioning decouples in-scope effects from out-of-scope generation
hypotheses.result: Cross-game transfer without task-specific training; generalizes to unseen scenes

title: LLMs as Noisy Channels: A Shannon Perspective on Model Capacity and Scaling Laws
task: Unified scaling law for LLMs via information-theoretic model
key_results: Shannon Scaling Law captures U-shaped degradation, catastrophic overtraining, quantization effects; R²=0.847 extrapolation from ≤6.9B to 12B models
comments: Maps model size↔bandwidth, tokens↔power; SNR insufficiency explains non-monotonic scaling missed by classical power laws.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM training follows Shannon channel capacity; insufficient SNR induces transition from improvement to U-shaped degradation
hypotheses.result: Shannon Scaling Law predicts overtraining and quantization collapse; outperforms monotonic baselines

title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
task: Staged training for perception vs. reasoning in VLMs
key_results: +1.5% reasoning accuracy with 20.8% shorter reasoning traces; +5.2% on WeMath, +3.7% on RealWorldQA vs. base model
comments: Decomposes post-training into three stages (visual perception → visual reasoning → textual reasoning); RL more effective than SFT for perception.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual perception is the limiting factor in VLM reasoning; staged training on perception before reasoning improves both
hypotheses.result: Superior perception reduces reasoning overhead; curriculum learning orthogonal to difficulty-based approaches

title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward
task: Camera-controlled video re-rendering via RL
key_results: Geo-Align outperforms SFT baselines in camera controllability and visual fidelity; uses metric 3D estimator to penalize rotation/translation deviations
comments: First RL framework for camera-controlled video; eliminates need for paired multi-view real-world data via synthetic trajectory conditioning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scale-aware perceptual reward via metric geometry enables accurate camera control without paired real-world data
hypotheses.result: RL outperforms SFT on out-of-distribution real-world videos

title: GenRecon: Bridging Generative Priors for Multi-View 3D Scene Reconstruction
task: High-fidelity multi-view 3D scene reconstruction via generative priors
key_results: GenRecon outperforms cutting-edge reconstruction methods by 16%; scales Trellis.2 object-level prior to multi-view scene generation
comments: Chunks scene into overlapping spatially-localized regions; projection-based conditioning lifts image features to 3D aligned with generative model.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Projection-based conditioning enables object-level generative priors to scale to scene-level multi-view reconstruction
hypotheses.result: High-fidelity faithful geometry outperforming reconstruction-only methods

title: Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining: Spectral Failures and High-Pass Remedies for VLA and RLVR
task: Optimizer for cross-modal vision-language-action training
key_results: Pion (high-pass Muon variant) reaches 100% LIBERO success at 1500 steps vs. 97% Muon/32% AdamW; extends to real Franka robot; outperforms baselines in RLVR post-training
comments: Addresses spectral failures of uniform whitening in low-rank settings via Promotion+Suppression mechanism; per-head mode preserves attention heterogeneity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-pass spectral filtering (anchor dominant SV at 1, suppress tail) mitigates noise amplification vs. uniform orthogonalization
hypotheses.result: Superior VLA and RLVR performance; stable training without per-head specialization collapse

title: LatentUMM: Dual Latent Alignment for Unified Multimodal Models
task: Unified multimodal model with consistent generation and understanding
key_results: LatentUMM improves multimodal consistency across diverse architectures; addresses semantic drift in generation-reencode cycles
comments: Explicitly aligns encoder-decoder transformations via cross-modal and dual-capacity alignment; latent dynamics stabilization via preference optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Functional inconsistency stems from unaligned encoder-decoder transformations, not shared representation lack
hypotheses.result: Dual latent alignment + stochastic rollouts improve bidirectional consistency

title: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers
task: Token selection for multi-view 3D reconstruction efficiency
key_results: 85% acceleration for 500-image scenes while maintaining/improving baseline performance; diversity-based inter-frame, entropy-guided intra-frame selection
comments: Two-stage framework (inter-frame + intra-frame) reduces quadratic attention cost; layer-aware sparsification crucial.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diversity-based inter-frame and entropy-guided intra-frame selection removes redundant tokens without quality loss
hypotheses.result: 85% speedup with improved performance suggests baseline includes significant redundancy

title: The Expense of Seeing: Attaining Trustworthy Multimodal Reasoning Within the Monolithic Paradigm

hypotheses.hypothesis: State-of-the-art VLMs exploit language priors to bypass visual representation bottlenecks; scaling language increases penalty of visual bottleneck
hypotheses.result: Modality Translation Protocol reveals functional blindness; language priors dominate vision input

title: HINT-SD: Targeted Hindsight Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
task: Targeted hindsight feedback for long-horizon agent training
key_results: HINT-SD improves dense per-turn feedback by up to 18.80%; 2.26× speedup (lower time per step) on BFCL v3 and AppWorld
comments: Uses full-trajectory hindsight to select failure-relevant actions; distills only on targeted spans, not every turn.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sparse targeted feedback on failure-relevant actions is more efficient and effective than dense per-turn feedback
hypotheses.result: Better accuracy and training efficiency vs. per-turn baselines

title: The Illusion of Reasoning: Exposing Evasive Data Contamination in LLMs via Zero-CoT Truncation
task: Detecting evasive data contamination in LLMs via truncated reasoning
key_results: ZCP successfully detects both direct and evasive (paraphrased) data contamination across multiple models; introduces Contamination Confidence metric beyond binary classification
comments: The insight that CoT reasoning masks memorization is clever, though the method's effectiveness may depend heavily on how well isomorphic perturbation captures meaningful task variations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models' generated reasoning steps mask underlying memorization from training data contamination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—truncating CoT exposes latent shortcut mappings indicating memorization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Comparing zero-CoT performance on original vs. isomorphically perturbed datasets isolates memorization from problem-solving
hypotheses.result: Supported—differential performance indicates contamination presence

title: Equilibrium Reasoners: Learning Attractors Enables Scalable Reasoning
task: Scalable test-time reasoning via learned attractors
key_results: Accuracy improved from 2.6% (feedforward) to 99%+ on Sudoku-Extreme; convergence to solution-aligned attractors confirmed with up to 40,000 equivalent layers of depth
comments: The attractor framework provides interpretability for iterative reasoning, though applicability beyond synthetic reasoning tasks remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generalizable reasoning arises from learning task-conditioned attractors whose fixed points correspond to valid solutions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: empirical gains from test-time scaling tightly coupled with convergence to solution-aligned attractors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Test-time compute can be adaptively allocated based on task difficulty without external verifiers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: simple cases converge in 1-5 steps; harder cases benefit from massive scaling up to 40,000 equivalent layers

title: HBV HBx protein masks epigenetic reader Spindlin1 via an inter-molecular zinc finger to subvert transcriptional control

key_results: HBx1-120 forms bivalent complex with Spindlin1 via hydrophobic interaction and inter-molecular zinc finger; masks Spindlin1's histone-tail recruitment region

hypotheses.hypothesis: HBx1-120 undergoes local folding and masks Spindlin1's histone-recruiting region via inter-molecular zinc finger
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; bivalent binding mechanism identified combining hydrophobic interaction with rare zinc finger architecture

title: Reconstructing calcium conductance in MCUb illuminates its molecular design for tuning the mitochondrial calcium uniporter

hypotheses.hypothesis: MCUb lacks conductance due to inability to bind EMRE and NTD-mediated autoinhibition

title: AreTomoLive: automated reconstruction of comprehensively corrected and denoised cryo-electron tomograms in real time and at high throughput

title: Interferometric scattering microscopy supports real-time mass-resolved label-free single-molecule immunoassay

hypotheses.hypothesis: iSCAT can resolve elementary protein-protein binding kinetics with single-molecule and mass sensitivity without labels

title: Defect-mediated n-type to p-type transition and enhanced thermoelectric performance in Bi1.8−xNixSb0.2Te3 alloys
task: Enhance thermoelectric performance via Ni-doping defect engineering in Bi-Sb-Te alloys
key_results: ZT increased by 125% to 0.09 at 350 K for x=0.04; n-to-p transition at x≥0.06 via acceptor defects; thermal conductivity reduced from 1.7 to 1.0 W/m·K
comments: Defect-mediated doping is a proven strategy, but the modest absolute ZT value (0.09) limits commercial viability despite relative improvement.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased Ni content increases phonon scattering via mass disorder

title: Freely controllable single-optical-frequency comb for highly sensitive cavity ring-down spectroscopy
task: Demonstrate freely controllable optical frequency comb for ultra-sensitive cavity ring-down spectroscopy
key_results: Single-mode extraction with 165 MHz resolution; maximum optical power >10 mW per mode; CH₄ 2ν₃ band sensitivity 4.2×10⁻¹¹ cm⁻¹, two orders of magnitude higher than prior comb-CRDS
comments: Combining spectral peak filtering, Raman amplification, and CRDS is innovative; applicability to weak absorbers beyond CH₄ requires demonstration.

title: Free transverse vibration analysis of Non-uniform Nano-Timoshenko beams rotating around two perpendicular axes using differential quadrature method
task: Analyze free transverse vibration of non-uniform nano-Timoshenko beams rotating around two orthogonal axes
key_results: Forward frequencies increase, backward decrease with rotational velocity; non-local elasticity increases scale-dependence; diameter profile changes significantly affect vibrational characteristics; critical velocities elevated by geometric optimization
comments: Differential quadrature method proves effective for rotor dynamics; practical applications would benefit from experimental validation of nonlocal elasticity predictions.

title: Band gap engineering in Al, Cu, N and Al/Cu Co-doped ZnO thin films: experimental study and quantum machine learning prediction

title: Regime-aware static and dynamic graph structure learning for stock price forecasting
task: Forecast stock prices using regime-aware learnable graph neural networks with HMM-driven market state detection
key_results: RL-GNN achieves MAPE ≈1.884%, RMSPE ≈2.569% on S&P 500, FTSE 100, SZSE-500; outperforms state-of-the-art; HMM identifies bull/bear/sideways regimes; learnable graph refines stock correlations dynamically
comments: Combining regime detection (HMM) with learnable GNN structure is principled; prediction accuracy modest compared to typical trading spreads; robustness to market regime shifts untested on out-of-sample future data.

title: Towards a theoretical understanding of Arctic amplification dynamics
task: Develop theoretical framework for Arctic amplification via nonlinear potential vorticity dynamics and static stability feedbacks
key_results: Critical diabatic threshold D≈0.03 marks dry-to-moist-nonlinear regime transition; Arctic currently at R>0.3 (nonlinear background); under SSP5-8.5, 88% of CMIP6 models exceed threshold by end-century; reduced stability amplifies baroclinic growth toward blocking wavelengths
comments: Rigorous scaling analysis connects surface warming to stratosphere-troposphere coupling; observational validation limited to ERA5; impacts on subseasonal predictability warrant further study.

model_io.model: Nonlinear PV dynamics, Green's function solutions, modified Eady model, ERA5 reanalysis, CMIP6 ensemble

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diabatic heating threshold D≈0.03 controls transition from production-limited to moist-nonlinear PV regime
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CMIP6 ensemble shows systematic migration into moist-nonlinear state under warming scenarios

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reduced static stability amplifies baroclinic instability toward high-latitude blocking scales
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Most unstable modes shift to longer wavelengths under weakened stability

title: Diagnosing high-pressure superconductors using diamond quantum sensors: a review

key_results: NV center magnetometry enables spatially resolved magnetic imaging at megabar pressures; quantitative visualization of superconducting phenomena under extreme conditions
comments: Review synthesizes recent methodological advances but lacks quantitative benchmarks (sensitivity, spatial resolution limits) for future reference.

title: Decoding cellular population dynamics through mechanistic modelling and statistical data analysis
task: Characterize mechanistic cell-cell communication networks beyond steady-state assumptions
key_results: No specific quantitative results reported; review identifying limitations of current steady-state modeling approaches
comments: This is a position/review paper advocating for dynamic mechanistic frameworks rather than presenting novel empirical findings; it highlights the conceptual gap between single-cell omics capabilities and mathematical modeling needs.

title: A kinetics-based model of haematopoiesis reveals extrinsic regulation of skewed lineage output from stem cells
task: Reconcile HSC heterogeneity through kinetics-based hierarchical modeling and identify extrinsic regulation of lineage bias
key_results: HSCs form a single linear hierarchy by reconstitution kinetics rather than discrete lineage-biased states; lineage bias arises from cell-extrinsic feedback and clonal competition filling compartment size limits
comments: The study elegantly resolves conflicting views of HSC heterogeneity by reframing transitory kinetic states as linear hierarchy, with extrinsic regulation as the mechanistic driver—a significant conceptual advancement supported by both single-cell transplantation data and mathematical modeling.

inputs: single-cell transplantation data from 1000+ purified HSCs

model_io.model: Mathematical model of clonal competition and feedback

hypotheses.hypothesis: HSC lineage bias represents discrete stable states
hypotheses.result: Rejected; biases are transitory states along linear kinetic hierarchy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Apparent lineage-biased outputs result from cell-extrinsic feedback and clonal competition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mathematical modeling and experimental modulation validated mechanism
